name: Clothing Head 2 Toe
old_description: Discover The Ultimate Destination For Top-quality Screenprinting and Embroidery Services.
about:
Clothing Head 2 Toe operates from Scottsdale, Arizona, where it has served the community for over 25 years as a locally owned apparel decoration shop. The business is led by President and Sales Director Vicki Canen, who brings more than 25 years of industry experience, alongside Vice President of Operations Rudy Jaramillo, embroidery department head Juan A. Cavazos, and assistant Lucy.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, sublimation, direct-to-film heat transfer, and tackle twill services, producing custom decorated apparel such as safety garments, jackets, duffle bags, and backpacks. It also offers graphic design support and promotional product sourcing, handling projects from concept through production with customer approval at each stage.

Customers span construction firms, healthcare providers, schools, youth sports leagues, corporate clients, government agencies, non‑profit organizations, and political campaigns. The company has outfitted little league teams, supplied safety apparel for construction crews, and produced branded merchandise for corporate and fundraising events.

The company emphasizes personal one‑on‑one attention, rapid turnaround, and a commitment to detail that includes client sign‑off before any job goes to press. Its stated differentiators are contemporary design ideas, consistent quality, and a collaborative process from initial concept to finished product.
